thought.text: The browser shows "code-server" - that's NOT our game! Check what process is on 8080:

reasoning_content: Let me check what's on port 8080 - is it code-server? The browser showed "Welcome to code-server". Let me check what process 760 is.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check process 760
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ps aux | grep 760 | head -5")
print("Process:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check what's on PM2 - different port
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 show areloria 2>&1 | head -15")
print("\nPM2:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
